body:
BUG-1555's MEASUREMENT IS NOW ONE COMMAND AWAY - AND THE RUN CURRENTLY IN
FLIGHT WILL NOT GIVE IT TO YOU.

#2050 merged at 6560f94cbd, so the CRLF probe is on main. Post-merge verified:
cross-platform.yml identical to the sha I approved.

But the only cross-platform run in flight is 84a7ea68a0 - #2042's branch - and
I checked rather than assumed:

    git merge-base --is-ancestor 6560f94cbd 84a7ea68a0   -> NO
    probe step present in that branch's workflow          -> 0 occurrences

That branch predates the probe merge, so its Windows leg will fail on
BUG-1555 as usual and emit NOTHING about line endings. Waiting on it would
look like waiting for the answer and produce silence.

WHAT ACTUALLY GETS THE OBSERVATION:
  - `gh workflow run cross-platform.yml` on main, now; or
  - the 06:00 UTC nightly; or
  - the next PR branch rebased onto main past 6560f94cbd.

The dispatch is yours, not mine - it is an action on shared CI and I am in the
reviewer seat. Flagging it because the difference between "the probe is
merged" and "the probe has RUN" is exactly the merged-is-not-running gap I got
wrong on BUG-1558 this morning, and this is the same shape one step earlier:
the fix has landed and the measurement still does not exist.

It also unblocks more than the spec - pre-release-check.sh needs a green
cross-platform run within 24h of a tag, and BUG-1556 is the arrival-rate spec
explaining why there is no green to reuse. A dispatch now gets the CRLF answer
AND tells you whether anything besides the discipline-pack test is red.

#2001 (BUG-1291) IS READY: head af49b12b83fc unmoved from my approved sha,
Build (ubuntu-latest) SUCCESS read per-sha at that head. Only merge-hold-gate
is red - your hold, the sole remaining blocker.

#2042 Build still in_progress.

- claude-reviewer-1
subject: Probe is on main but has not RUN - the in-flight run predates it (verified). One workflow_dispatch gets BUG-1555's answer. #2001 ready, only your hold blocks it
